title: A constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on a qcqs scheme is the inverse image of one on a Noetherian scheme
statement:
Let $X$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring and $F$ a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], an object of $\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Then there are a Noetherian scheme $X'$ (locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact; one may take $X'$ of finite type over $\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$), a morphism of schemes $
u:X	o X'$, a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules $F'$ on $X'_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] and an isomorphism of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules $
u^{-1}F'\cong F$, where $
u^{-1}$ is the inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. (Stacks states the underlying Lemma 09YU (3) for Noetherian $\Lambda$; a finite ring is Noetherian.)

source.place: Lemma 09Z7 (lemma-constructible-maps-into-constant-general), proof, first paragraph up to 'is the pullback of a similar constructible sheaf F_t over X_t for some t' (etale-cohomology.tex ~line 13066), which combines Limits, Proposition 01ZA (limits-proposition-approximate) and the essential surjectivity part of Lemma 09YU (3) (lemma-category-is-colimit, etale-cohomology.tex line 12552)

proof.text: *Noetherian approximation of $X$.* Since $X$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, by [prop-nagata-noetherian-inverse-system] it admits a Noetherian approximation [def-nagata-noetherian-inverse-system]: a small cofiltered category $\mathcal I$, a functor $\lambda\mapsto S_\lambda$ from $\mathcal I$ to schemes such that every $S_\lambda$ is of finite type over $\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$ (its structure morphism to $\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$ is locally of finite type and $S_\lambda$ is quasi-compact) and every transition morphism $S_\mu\to S_\lambda$ is affine, and a limit cone $(X,(p_\lambda:X\to S_\lambda)_\lambda)$ of this diagram in the category of schemes. (Stacks cites Limits, Proposition 01ZA, which gives directly a directed set; the DAG node, whose Lean is closed, gives a cofiltered index category, and step 2 passes to a directed set.)

source.place: Lemma 09Z7 (lemma-constructible-maps-into-constant-general), proof, first paragraph, etale-cohomology.tex lines 13063-13072: 'by Limits, Proposition 01ZA we can write X = lim_{t in T} X_t with each X_t of finite type over Spec(Z) and with affine transition morphisms'; literature/stacks-project/limits.tex, Proposition 01ZA (proposition-approximate), line 1255

proof.text: Reindex the approximation N by applying CategoryTheory.IsFiltered.exists_directed to N.Iᵒᵖ [lem-weil-pbc-cofiltered-limit-directed-reindex]. This gives a nonempty directed partial order I and a final functor G : I ⥤ N.Iᵒᵖ. Its left opposite G.leftOp is initial. Put D = G.leftOp ⋙ N.D and c = (Cone.mk X N.π).whisker G.leftOp. Functor.Initial.isLimitWhiskerEquiv transports N.isLimit to IsLimit c. Affineness of D.map follows directly from N.isAffineHom_map [pqf-def-affine-morphism]. No separate existence theorem for the limit is used.

source.place: Lemma 0032 (lemma-directed-category-system), line 2710; the source (Limits 01ZA) states the approximation over a directed set directly

proof.text: For each i : Iᵒᵖ, D.obj i is N.D.obj (G.leftOp.obj i). Use the existing proved instance Scheme.NoetherianApproximation.isNoetherian_obj, whose proof applies LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian over Spec of the lifted integers [pqf-lem-locnoeth-lft], together with N.compactSpace_obj and the definition of a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth]. Thus each D.obj i is Noetherian and quasi-compact; IsLocallyNoetherian.quasiSeparatedSpace [lem-weil-pbc-locally-noetherian-quasi-separated] supplies quasi-separatedness [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions].

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 01T6 (lemma-finite-type-noetherian); Properties, Lemma 01OY (properties.tex line 481); the source (09Z7 proof, line 13063: 'reduce this lemma to the Noetherian case') uses that X_t is Noetherian without comment

proof.text: *Descent of $F$ to a stage.* By steps 2 and 3, $(X_t,f_{st})_{t\in T}$ is an inverse system over a directed set with affine transition morphisms and quasi-compact and quasi-separated terms, with limit $X$ and projections $\nu_t$. By [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-module-limit-descent] (Stacks 09YU (3), essential surjectivity) applied to it, the finite (hence Noetherian) ring $\Lambda$ and the constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules $F$ on $X_{\Et}$, there are $t\in T$, a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules $F_t$ on $(X_t)_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] and an isomorphism of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules $\alpha:\nu_t^{-1}F_t\xrightarrow{\sim}F$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image].

source.place: Lemma 09Z7 (lemma-constructible-maps-into-constant-general), proof, first paragraph, etale-cohomology.tex lines 13063-13072: 'By Lemma 09YU the category of constructible sheaves (of sets, abelian groups, or Lambda-modules) on X_etale is the colimit of the corresponding categories for X_t. Thus our constructible sheaf F is the pullback of a similar constructible sheaf F_t over X_t for some t'

proof.text:
*Conclusion.* Put $X'=X_t$, $
u=
u_t:X	o X'$ and $F'=F_t$. By step 3, $X'$ is Noetherian and of finite type over $\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$; by step 4, $F'$ is a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $X'_{\Et}$ and $\alpha:
u^{-1}F'\cong F$. This is the assertion.
